title: Elihu Speaks: God's Works in Nature

questions.question: At this also my heart trembles and leaps out of its what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:1 (ESV): "At this also my heart trembles and leaps out of its place."

questions.question: Keep listening to the thunder of his voice and the rumbling that comes from his what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:2 (ESV): "Keep listening to the thunder of his voice and the rumbling that comes from his mouth."

questions.question: Under the whole heaven he lets it go, and his lightning to the corners of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:3 (ESV): "Under the whole heaven he lets it go, and his lightning to the corners of the earth."

questions.question: God thunders wondrously with his voice; he does great things that we cannot what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:5 (ESV): "God thunders wondrously with his voice; he does great things that we cannot comprehend."

questions.question: For to the snow he says, 'Fall on the earth,' likewise to the what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:6 (ESV): "For to the snow he says, 'Fall on the earth,' likewise to the downpour, his mighty downpour."

questions.question: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he made may know it.
options: False (all men may know his work)
questions.explanation: Job 37:7 (ESV): "He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he made may know it." (or "know his work" depending on footnote/interpretation, strictly ESV text: "that all men whom he made may know it.")

questions.question: By the breath of God ice is given, and the broad waters are what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:10 (ESV): "By the breath of God ice is given, and the broad waters are frozen fast."

questions.question: He loads the thick cloud with moisture; the clouds scatter his what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:11 (ESV): "He loads the thick cloud with moisture; the clouds scatter his lightning."

questions.question: Whether for correction or for his land or for love, he causes it to what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:13 (ESV): "Whether for correction or for his land or for love, he causes it to happen."

questions.question: Do you know how the clouds hang poised, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:16 (ESV): "Do you know how the clouds hang poised, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge,"

questions.question: You whose garments are hot when the earth is still because of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:17 (ESV): "you whose garments are hot when the earth is still because of the south wind?"

questions.question: Can you, like him, spread out the skies, hard as a cast metal what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:18 (ESV): "Can you, like him, spread out the skies, hard as a cast metal mirror?"

questions.question: Teach us what we shall say to him; we cannot draw up our case because of what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:19 (ESV): "Teach us what we shall say to him; we cannot draw up our case because of darkness."

questions.question: Out of the north comes what kind of splendor?
questions.explanation: Job 37:22 (ESV): "Out of the north comes golden splendor; God is clothed with awesome majesty."

questions.question: Therefore men fear him; he does not regard any who are what?
questions.explanation: Job 37:24 (ESV): "Therefore men fear him; he does not regard any who are wise in their own conceit."

key_verse_text: God thunders wondrously with his voice; he does great things that we cannot comprehend.
